6cb56f0169f2c06b335e6724fefd4266e7995de7:
query ListScenes($storyboardId: ID!) {
  scenes(storyboardId: $storyboardId) {
    id
    storyboardId
    sceneNumber
    textDescription
    mediaType
    mediaUrl
    startTimeSeconds
    durationSeconds
    transitionType
    createdAt
    updatedAt
  }
}
e4467cc30c1f0d91102f0a90f8dcd9b9a5379703:
query GetScene($id: ID!) {
  scene(id: $id) {
    id
    storyboardId
    sceneNumber
    textDescription
    mediaType
    mediaUrl
    startTimeSeconds
    durationSeconds
    transitionType
    createdAt
    updatedAt
  }
}
